sourceCountSummary.robloxGamePage: No item-level hat table in public page description

uncertainFacts: BloxInformer live HTML fetched on 2026-05-23 includes Lava Wizard Hat, but BloxInformer's text-only cache and older PGG/Gamezebo/Beebom/AllThings.How pages list only the three Roger shop hats.

Starlight Hat has a source conflict: BloxInformer lists HP +20 and 8K Gold, while PGG and Gamezebo list HP +40 and 8K Gold. Beebom says Starlight gives the same HP boost as Golden Reverie, so this dataset uses +40 HP with an in-game verification caveat.

items.name: Starmoon Hat
items.sourceLocation: Roger's Equipment Shop Wizard Hat tab at spawn
items.progressionUse: Early HP upgrade while saving for stronger wands, potions, robes, and later hats.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer, PGG, and Gamezebo agree on +20 HP and 1.2K Gold. Gamezebo lists the rarity as Rare.

items.name: Golden Reverie Hat
items.sourceLocation: Roger's Equipment Shop Wizard Hat tab at spawn
items.progressionUse: Main 8K defensive buy for players who need more HP before tougher fights.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer, PGG, and Gamezebo agree on +40 HP and 8K Gold. Gamezebo lists the rarity as Epic.

items.name: Starlight Hat
items.sourceLocation: Roger's Equipment Shop Wizard Hat tab at spawn
items.progressionUse: Alternative 8K defensive buy; check the in-game stat line before choosing it over Golden Reverie.
items.verificationNote: Dataset uses +40 HP because PGG and Gamezebo both list Starlight Hat at +40 HP and 8K Gold, and Beebom says Starlight gives the same HP boost as Golden Reverie. BloxInformer lists Starlight Hat at +20 HP and 8K Gold, so this row needs in-game confirmation before production publishing.

items.name: Lava Wizard Hat
items.sourceLocation: Behind the fiery Lava waterfall next to the base in the Sea of Oblivion region
items.progressionUse: Sea of Oblivion utility hat for players who need HP plus lava resistance on New Mainland routes.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer live HTML fetched on 2026-05-23 lists Lava Wizard Hat with +40 HP, +100% Lava Resistance, 10K Gold, and a Sea of Oblivion lava waterfall location. Older PGG, Gamezebo, Beebom, and AllThings.How pages do not include this New Mainland hat.
